versions.changelog:
Initial release of kronos-signals-api skill.

- Integrates Kronos Crypto Data API for real-time crypto market data, derivatives intelligence, ML forecasts, and market alerts.
- Supports x402 USDC micropayments on Base mainnet (EIP-3009 gasless).
- Provides endpoints for spot prices, derivatives signals, regime alerts, market-wide snapshots, candlestick (OHLC) data, realized volatility, and more.
- Free health and stats endpoints; all other endpoints are pay-per-call ($0.01–$0.08 USDC).
- Covers 16 major crypto assets, with optimized endpoints for batch requests and full snapshot data.
